panlex_hebrew_english_meanings_20240301.declared_from: The record's own unit: in 28439 of 28439 rows the route is the whole definition, so the provider has one region and no head. 27611 routes carry no mark at all; 28427 carry no comma. PanLex's unit is one lexical expression per record, and its marks are overwhelmingly the spelling of that expression: of 908 mark occurrences, 890 are inside one expression (hyphens in compounds, apostrophes, abbreviation periods, title and markup punctuation). Two marks divide, and only by shape: a comma in a field whose every piece is one word (15 commas, 8 routes — source glosses PanLex left packed in one expression), and a slash between two complete expressions (3 routes). The other 4 comma routes are one expression each.

panlex_hebrew_english_meanings_20240301.precedence_note: Slash first, then comma inside each slash side, as the Strong's declaration orders them. No route of this provider carries both, so the order is declared, not exercised. Parentheses scope both: a comma or slash inside '(' ')' never divides (no route carries one).

undeclared_mark.rule: closure: a mark absent from this declaration ships the row whole and is reported

comma_not_a_one_word_list.rule: ship whole: the comma is inside one expression (postposed 'to', a coordinated idiom, a proper name, a packed shared tail)

shared_tail_never_distributed.rule: 'get, become late' is not rewritten as 'get late' + 'become late' and not cut to 'get' + 'become late'; it ships whole

separates_on.declared_from: 12 routes carry a comma (19 commas) and 3 carry a slash; none carries one inside parentheses.
separates_on.rule: Separate on a depth-0 slash with no space on either side when both sides are complete expressions (a capitalized name each, or a 'the ...' phrase each). Then, inside each side, separate on depth-0 commas only when every comma piece is one word, none is a bare conjunction and the last is not 'to'. Every piece is kept, each a run of the provider's characters; they must rejoin to the route. Nothing is distributed, stripped or joined.
separates_on.result: 11 routes divide into 29 readings (8 by comma, 3 by slash); 28428 ship whole.
separates_on.machine_gap: declaration-v1.mjs reads one separates_on.mark and divides on it unconditionally. This declaration needs two marks and a per-field shape condition on the comma; fed to that machine as written it would divide 'hook, line and sinker', 'New York, New York', 'lay-down, to' and 'get, become late'. census.mjs's declDivide is the reference application until the machine reads shapes.

panlex_hebrew_english_meanings_20240301.not_done_here: No piece is distributed across a shared head or tail, no sigil or markup is stripped ('#Barcelona |Barcelona', 'Pole_person', 'labor '' ''', 'lioness ж.' ship as written), and no reading is taken from anywhere but the route — the route is the whole definition.
